items.text: Fixed an issue with weapon recoil when using optical and thermal sights, as well as gear loss caused by long loading times when entering an Isolated Raid. New monsters no longer spawn near players, the contract list can now be expanded directly in the raid menu, investigations are now distributed among characters based on their specialization, the grappling hook now works in and on the surface of water, and a new pair of portals have been added to the "Icarus Offices," along with increased loot.
Distributed Investigations among characters by topic, according to their specialization.
Added a hover tooltip to the "Choose a Case" list that shows unlocked stages and their progress.
Equipment investigations now display the actual item as the main reward instead of the unlock.

Reworked the Warden's task: the door that opens with the key is now marked on the map, the room has more loot spots, and each of them is guaranteed to give a reward. The Warden's Wallet is now an Epic item that can be kept or processed in the Refiner.
Moved a lever in the "Protocol" Investigation that was completely blocked by environment objects to a more accessible spot.
Fixed monster capture task progress resetting when the trap with the monster was placed in the Robot Dog's backpack.
Fixed an issue where weapons awarded for investigation contracts at the Power Plant were given without a magazine.
Added a toggle to the raid menu, above the raid information on the right, this will now expand the full contract list.
Added a hint to the raid selection dropdowns explaining how to select one or more raids with a mouse or gamepad.
Rare perks are now highlighted in the perk tree.
Fixed chronotrace icons in the Refiner message when deploying to a raid.
Prevented new monsters from spawning in monster habitats while players are nearby.
Reduced RPG shaped-charge jet damage to 200 (from 1,200). A single rocket is no longer enough to kill an Alpha Mimic but still destroys vehicles. Rocket explosion damage has not changed.
Bullets can now penetrate metal mesh.
The rope can now be used underwater and on the surface of the water, and can be used to pull a teammate out of the water.
Turned Soldiers can now navigate around doors correctly again.
Fixed items falling through the ground after spawning and dropping.
Fixed an issue where a flashlight attached to the underbarrel mount did not appear in the action selection menu.
Unified the aim point rule for all sights: weapon zoom and field of view no longer shift the point of impact. Optical and thermal sights no longer affect weapon recoil.
Moved the monster trap to the "Grenades" category in storage and the Workshop (they were previously in "Miscellaneous").
Made all soundtrack CDs fit the "Any CD" slot in fusion (for example, for the Icarus Medbay pass); the track stays unlocked.
Changed badge and stamp albums, as well as regular wallets, to dismantle into idea and fiber chronotraces; their total amount is unchanged.
Changed armor plates to move to the first suitable free slot when switching Body Sleeves instead of going to storage. Fixed an error when re-equipping them.
Renamed HX6 suppressors to HX6 7.62 and HX6 5.45.
Fixed an error that prevented changing the camouflage of the "Knight" Body Sleeve.
Icarus Offices: added a new pair of portals between the tilted gravity island at the lower east entrance and the inverted floor at the top of the building.
Fixed gear loss that occured when loading into an Isolated Raid took too long. A clear error message is now shown on loading timeout.
Made a new Isolated Raid start immediately if the previous one was interrupted. Gear from the interrupted raid is returned.
Removed the old zone circle from the map after the zone shrinks in raids with zone collapse.
Power Plant: removed separate markers from key containers. You will now be guided by the marker of the key itself, which disappears once it is picked up.
Icarus Offices: significantly increased the chance of finding valuable items in the Icarus Medbay, hotel rooms, and the Warden's storeroom.
Icarus Offices: closed off access to the Warden's storeroom using the anchor and rope.
Fixed the Relativity sports car being labeled as an ATV during extraction.
Moved the fusion device to the east wall, where it now stands in a row with the Refiner.
Changed the Relativity sports car deployment marker in the Shelter to look like a golden ticket. It can be hung on the wall like a painting.
Your squadmates' body sleeve appearance settings are now displayed while at the Shelter.
Improved the volume balance between car trunk sounds, the sound of a trunk closing is now quieter.

On Linux, fixed an issue where keyboards, mice, RGB lighting controllers, and other non-gamepad devices were incorrectly recognized by the system as joysticks, causing unwanted automatic scrolling. Such devices are now correctly identified and no longer cause this issue.
Fixed an issue where color tags in contract names were displayed as raw text instead of applying the color in the debriefing tasks tab and shop info.

This update adds a button that lets you turn in all completed investigation stages at once, and shop tabs no longer disappear after a raid. Fire now burns the ground and grass, and the RPG-7 is effective against vehicles and dangerous enemies again. We also fixed the armored SUV's window protection, portal functionality, and a number of interface bugs.
Gameplay and Balance
Fixed a bug where portals didn't account for the direction the player entered from.
The camera no longer clips through the ceiling when jumping or climbing onto an obstacle.
The armored SUV's windows once again protect the driver and passengers.
It is no longer possible to kill squad teammates in the shelter or at the shooting range.
Weapons and Items
The monster grenade dropped from a drone now works the same way as when thrown by hand.
Added a new model for the 300 BLK (7.62x35) ammo box.
In the item inspection window, glasses and headwear now display at the correct scale and position.
The PG-7VL rocket now deals damage not only from the explosion but also from the shaped charge jet. This makes the RPG-7 extremely effective against vehicles and especially dangerous anomalies.
Investigations
Added a button to the investigation terminal for turning in all completed stages at once. You no longer need to submit them one by one.
Graphics
Fire now leaves scorched earth and burnt grass behind. Ash rises above burning grass.
Flamethrower flames on walls and slopes now rise upward instead of spreading along the surface.
In Vulkan mode, distant grass no longer shifts when the camera moves and no longer disappears at long distances.
Grass on floating islands no longer flickers when the camera rotates. Previously, due to a bug, it would appear and disappear depending on the camera's position.
Interface
Shop tabs no longer disappear after exiting a raid.
The top tabs are now wider, making them easier to click with the mouse.
The item replicator now immediately reports a lack of resources needed to restore a recipe, without an extra confirmation window.
Tokens in storage are now sorted by rarity, with the rarest ones first.
Voice Chat
In a raid without a squad, the voice chat icon no longer lights up when you speak into the microphone.
Localization
Added a list of creatures that can be caught with the monster trap to its description.
The Agency has stabilized a portal to the complex floating above Saltriver City. Now you can enter the "Vanilla" skyscraper and find out what secrets the Icarus corporation is hiding in its offices.

Signals are coming in from the power plant in Anguka Anga, and a new threat has been spotted on Dalniy Island. You will need to determine the level of danger at these sites, the raids are already open.

To increase operatives' effectiveness, new equipment, vehicles, and weapons have arrived: an APC, a paratrike, a jetpack, and fresh weapon models. We've also changed the behavior of Hellhounds, Ball Lightning, and the Distorted – details in the "Monsters and Anomalies" section.
Icarus Offices (Saltriver City)
Powerplant (Ankuga Anga)
Rare and epic items can now be found in the police department’s containers. The valuable loot zone is marked on the raid map.
Armories and military containers now hold US/NATO weapons and NATO-caliber ammunition, while household containers hold pistols and hunting weapons.
On American locations, vending machines now contain food and drinks, and server cabinets contain computer parts.
On all raid maps, loot now thematically matches the place where you find it. Desks hold more stationery, lockers more tools, offices more documents, and ammo boxes more ammunition.
Added new themed items. Some existing items have been split by rarity.
New loot containers have appeared in America and Africa: wall-mounted first aid kits and modular furniture.
Valuable loot zone panels on the raid map now show pictures of those places.
Many objects are now destructible: doors, electrical panels, glass, windows, bunker objects. Street objects in Saltriver City and the Park break under vehicle wheels.
6P67 Assault Rifle (5,45x39)
STG77 A3 .300 BLK Assault Rifle
Wolverine Assault Rifle
AEK-999 Machine gun
KSVK Bolt-action rifle.
FD-12 Shotgun
RDG-U Smoke grenade
BJ10 Jetpack
A.C.U. (Anomaly Container Unit) — traps that capture monsters. A full trap becomes a grenade: throw it to release the captured monsters near enemies.

Added a rope anchor. Attach it at a high spot, such as on the edge of a ledge. You can use the rope to descend to a lower level or climb up to the anchor point. While the rope is free, any player can use it.
Fixed inaccurate firing through the STG77 A1 integrated scope.
Added module slots to the M4A1 and M110A1: side tactical rails and underbarrel mounts.
The weight of an installed modification now replaces the weight of the stock part instead of adding to it. Applied to the AK-74 for now.
PK-AV: improved visibility through the scope
When realistic aiming is enabled, the weapon model is now visible through the scope lens. The reticle is centered, and the image darkens less when the eye shifts relative to the eyepiece.
When the weapon sways due to breathing or fatigue, the camera now moves together with it. The reticule no longer diverges from the point of impact.
Weapon sway while moving now depends on movement speed and is reduced while aiming.

When leaning left, the character now shifts the weapon to the left shoulder, making it easier to shoot from behind cover. Shoulder swapping works with all weapons except grenade launchers and melee weapons.
Reduced muzzle flash on assault rifles: it no longer obstructs the view. Shot effects for the RSh-12 and ASh-12 have also been adjusted.
The VSSK "Vykhlop" supressor is no longer a separate module: it is now built into the rifle and cannot be removed. The rifle's characteristics have also been adjusted.
Animations for the Makarov pistol have been updated.
Added a setting for sight behavior under heavy recoil: when enabled, the crosshair will smoothly return to the point it was aimed at before you started firing.
Fixed a bug that prevented changing the zeroing distance on weapons without attachments.
Fixed a bug that caused the weapon-mounted flashlight to turn off after climbing a ladder.
Fixed a bug where a night vision device picked up from the ground and attached to a helmet remained visible lying on the ground.
Improved melee hit detection — strikes follow the look direction more precisely.
Fixed a bug where quick-throwing a grenade wouldn't work even when you had grenades in your inventory.
Fixed a bug where unjamming a weapon didn't work while in the passenger seat of a vehicle.
Fixed a bug where the muzzle flash from shots could differ from the weapon's physical position.
Banshee — encountered in the Icarus raid in Saltriver City.
Omega Mimic — an armored Mimic boss in the updated Escape from Dogorsk raid.
Wall-climber Mimic. Encountered in Saltriver City, can attack from distance via clumbs of matter.
Doll - new enemy that disguises itself as a toy.
Hellhound pups: portals release them next to adult hounds. Pups do not attack — they circle the target and howl, and scatter once the pack leader dies.
The behavior of the Distorted and Hellhounds has been changed. Fights with them will now be more predictable.
Ball Lightning has become a bit more aggressive: it now actively pursues players and shoots down drones with an electrical discharge.
The Alpha Mimic in Dogorsk and Shegolskoe takes the form of one of seven Soviet cars, and in Africa one of eight local vehicles. After death its body stays in place and becomes a loot container.
Fixed enemies visually sinking through the pier on Ozernoe.
Fixed a bug that caused Distorteds to slide during attacks.
Monster habitats now warn of incoming monsters with a sound and a visual effect.
Unified the clearing and activation mechanics for habitats: small nests now also require installing a device.
Large habitat spots now spawn monsters gradually over a longer period of time, instead of all at once.
A Soviet APC armed with a 30mm cannon and a crew of seven people.
Paratrike (single-seat).
New example of american classic car in Saltriver City.
Added rusty variants of Soviet vehicles and moss-covered variants of American vehicles. These vehicles have lower engine power and worse road grip.

Updated wheeled vehicle physics. Front-wheel, rear-wheel, and all-wheel drive vehicles now behave differently. Giving too much throttle causes the wheels to spin, while sharp braking locks them up. Engine braking has been added.

Reworked damage model. Most engines can be disabled with several shots through the body, while the armoured off-road’s armor is tougher. A damaged fuel tank now leaks. Glass and headlights shatter, and a shot-out headlight goes dark.
Added voxel armor for armored vehicles: repeated hits to the same spot gradually penetrate the armor, after which bullets pass inside.
Vehicles react to melee hits and wheel hits with effects and sounds.
Wheels kick up dust, dirt and splashes depending on the surface.
The driver of a closed vehicle can no longer shoot from the cab; shooting from the driver's seat remains in open vehicles.
While in a vehicle you can drop items, but you cannot pick them up from the ground or equip gear.
The driver can no longer use medkits while driving.
Turn signals are noticeably brighter, and the american pickup headlights now light up the road.
Fixed vehicle acceleration: reverse is no longer faster than forward.
Fixed engine damage not showing in the UI.

Added a squad ping system: a ping is placed where the player is facing and is announced to the squad with a voice line, sound and gesture. Holding the ping key opens a radial menu: enemy, go here, loot, watch, hold, cover, need help. Pings are shown on the map, compass, smartwatch and in the world; enemy pings are red. Ping keys can be rebound in a separate controls section.
If a jump falls short of a roof edge, holding the jump button lets you grab the ledge and pull yourself up.
When all body parts are equally damaged, healing starts with the head, then the torso, arms and legs. A body part with noticeably more damage is still healed first.
Even if storage is full, it is now possible equip and use the secure container.
Fixed a bug where keys wouldn't unlock doors.
Industrial gas cylinders now explode when destroyed.
Quest items for Agency tasks are now issued from the squad container — one per task zone not yet completed. Items can be handed to teammates; a lost item is not reissued.
Quest items in the secure container and in robodog bags count toward tasks both during the raid and after extraction — even after the player's death.
The raid filter on the investigations screen now lets you select several raids at once.
In Mariko Sato's investigations, fixed a bug that prevented progress from being credited in item refining tasks.
Fixed task items floating in the air, and multi-device installation tasks where all devices could be placed in a single zone.
Fixed tasks that require photographing several targets.
Harmonization rewards can be claimed with a full stash — they go to temporary storage.
The RSh-12 investigation has been moved to Monolith level ETA.
Added subcategory filters to the Shop: weapons by class, modules and ammo by type, ammo "for equipped weapons"; ammo and magazines are now separate.
Fixed the permanent rented gear offer mistakenly granting a Replicator queue upgrade.
The Workshop interface has been updated. You can now access the Replicator, Fusion, or Refiner from the main screen.
It is now possible to perform a Fusion directly into a slot via the context menu or a tile in the menu.

Through the context menu, items can now not only be added to favorites but also marked for quick recycling. Two buttons have been added under the Refiner tab: one sends all marked items from storage for recycling, the other – from the inventory.
Fixed the MP 40, PPSh-41, Thompson and TT Fusion recipes disappearing after a self-wipe.
The minimum replication time has been reduced from 30 to 5 seconds, the fusion cost of those items has been reduced.

The appearance customization menu is now divided into two tabs. The "Style" tab is used to configure the mask, glasses, headgear, hairstyle, beard, tattoos, and face paint. The "Appearance" tab is used to configure camouflage and shoulder straps.
Glasses are now a separate item — any pair can be worn on any character. Six new pairs of glasses have been added.
Added six new eye colors, including heterochromia.
Hair color is now set by two natural pigments and a dye of any shade — black, platinum and vibrant hair colors are available.
All characters share a single list of thirteen hats, including three new ones.

Camouflage is no longer worn as an item: now it is selected on the "Appearance" tab. Shoulder straps are also configured there. The separate slot for the mask has been removed: now it can be enabled in the "Style" tab.

Glasses, hats, tattoos and war paint are items that must be obtained; hairstyles are open from start. Locked items show a lock, can be tried on, and their tooltip shows where to get them. Harmonization Cycle goods have a "Preview" button.
The skin color model has been reworked — skin no longer looks grayish-beige.
Six Body Sleeves now feature forearm armor that adapts to your clothing color and camouflage.
Appearance customization is now available for the Old Man, Mirage, Hunter, Liquidator and Phantom; the Liquidator head supports tattoos again. The Viper suit mask can be taken off.
Added a background for the avatar card: a choice of four patterns and 12 colors. The selected background is visible to your squadmates.
Squadmates in the shelter are shown live: they walk, crouch, aim and use emotes. Their looks are visible on the raid preparation screen, in the debriefing and the raid log.
A character tab has been added to the character customization menu, where you can choose a name for the sleeve, a pose, and an animation.
Added "Enter shooting range" and "Leave shooting range" to the shelter menu.

Added a shelf for dog tags. Dog tags placed on it are preserved after creating a personal Timeline. It holds a maximum of 100 tags. If a tag is not placed on the shelf or in the shelter, it will disappear when a new Timeline is created. Dog tags take up space in the inventory.
Statue remains can now be placed at the base. Their appearance has been updated.

A "System" tab has been added to the raid menu. In addition to the settings and commands from the former dropdown menu, it now includes a music player, contacts, and a list of players who were heard nearby. At the top of the tab, the squad members are displayed: their nicknames, avatars, weapons and microphone icons.
The item stack-splitting window has been reworked.
On the raid results screen, items evacuated via the secure container or the robo-dog are now shown separately. Your character and avatar are displayed with the appearance you've selected.
If an action requires holding down a key, a ring around its icon in the tooltip gradually fills in.
The automatic display of item tooltips can now be disabled in the settings. This is especially handy on the Steam Deck.
The item weight shown in tooltips now accounts for the weight of attachments and ammo. The weapon showcase also lists the weight of the stock parts.
The login screen background is now animated.
A warning about items placed in your hideout now appears before the start of a Personal Timeline.

DirectX 12 is now selected by default on NVIDIA GTX 900-series and newer graphics cards, as well as on AMD graphics cards with RDNA architecture. DirectX 11 is used by default on integrated Intel graphics.
Ray tracing has been added. It is available only on PC, Xbox Series X, and PlayStation 5 Pro. On Xbox Series X and PlayStation 5 Pro, it is enabled with the "Quality Mode" graphics setting.
Physical shell casings have been added to the "High" and "Ultra" presets. In zones with gravity, local gravity affects the casings.

Effects that may cause motion sickness have been softened: ripples under the evacuation portal have been removed, the distortion effect on spawn has been reduced, and image ghosting after an explosion has been weakened.
On Linux, you can now change vertical sync settings and resolution without restarting the game.
A charring effect has been added for soldiers and monsters. After taking fire damage, burn marks remain on the body and gear. The body of a character killed by fire now appears charred.
Performance in Vulkan has been improved through Variable Rate Shading (VRS).
Performance has been improved in the "Store," "Monolith," and "Harmonization" menus, when looking at a forest through a scope, and near Banshees and other shadow-casting light sources.
Screen-space reflection rendering has been optimized.
Load on the main and worker CPU threads has been reduced: object culling, vegetation gathering, and transparent object sorting are now faster and run in parallel.
Wind shaders for vegetation and trees have been simplified. On consoles, the draw distance for vegetation detail and wind effects has been reduced.
The number of decorative objects in areas with Flowermen has been reduced.
VRAM usage on Xbox Series S and PC has been reduced.
On handheld PCs, motion blur is now disabled by default.
The image in thermal scopes has been reworked. Colors now look more natural, and shaded and distant surfaces appear cooler. The thermal image now fits precisely within the scope lens.
The PK-AV red dot sight now simulates aiming with both eyes open, so its long body blocks much less of the view.
Fixed a rare bug that caused bushes to disappear when looking through a sniper scope.
Fixed artifacts that appeared over bright crosshairs in sniper scopes.
When looking through a scope, the lenses of other nearby scopes no longer look like black spots.
Fixed rare graphical artifacts on inventory and shop icons.
Fixed water flickering. A gap in the water surface no longer appears under the camera.
Fixed GPU hitching caused by bullet holes in glass.
Fixed flickering of Active Matter piles while collecting them.
In DirectX 11, bullet holes and decals are once again displayed on glass.
Screens and portals no longer glow white due to blood traces and bullet holes. Static decals no longer display on top of portals.
Fixed overly bright or bluish indoor reflections that, for example, made windows in dark rooms appear to glow.
Fixed indoor global illumination, which was too dark and had a blue tint.
Fixed a bug where, at low shadow quality, trees near the player had no shadows for the first 1–2 seconds after appearing.
Water reflections no longer disappear near shorelines.
Fixed trailing artifacts behind moving objects.
Small ripples on water no longer vanish during strong waves.
Fixed the incorrect color display of vines on PS5.
Fixed FSR frame generation in HDR mode. Every other frame was dark and oversaturated, and the game could crash on AMD graphics cards.
In nearby voice chat, voices now fade smoothly with distance and remain intelligible at medium range.
Added a "Voice via server only" setting. You can also choose who to establish direct voice connections with: no one, friends and squad members, friends only, or everyone.
Each type of squad marker now has its own sound.
Added a sound for the activation of a nest's minor rift. It can be heard within a 50 m radius.
Added a sound effect for when a Mimic teleports a player.
Fixed a bug where connecting a DualSense or DUALSHOCK 4 to a PC switched all audio to the controller's speaker.
The sounds of your own gunshots now muffle enemy footsteps less.
Added voiced quick phrases in French, Spanish, and Portuguese.
The "SFX Volume" slider no longer affects music in the player. Its volume is now adjusted separately from sound effects volume.
Fixed the positioning of the flyover sound during airdrop cargo delivery.
Doors and cabinets no longer muffle their own sounds.
The sounds of sleeping Flowermen now blend better with ambient sounds. Flowermen make less noise when killed.
Softened low frequencies in some interface sounds.

If connection drops, the game immediately offers to reconnect to the raid. There's no longer any need to restart the game. Also fixed a bug that prevented starting a new raid search after a connection drop.
You can now join a cooperative Isolated raid that has already started.
In Hired Ops, two raids are now available at the same time, so matches start with a full roster more frequently.
On Dalniy Island, the raid rotation has been changed: at least one classic raid: Shegolskoe, Factory, or Ozernoe is now always available.
Fixed a bug that allowed the number of players in a raid to exceed the set limit.
The "Ready" mark no longer resets on its own.
Fixed depth of field behavior in the sniper scope.
Fixed the updating of the friends and blocked players lists.
Updated translations for all supported languages, including separate updates to Spanish and German.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45276524/55f88ef3971c12365b0df0f6623395cf4b268b8f.jpg"]The Investigation "Thin Boundary" is still available to complete: those who haven't yet can still finish it before a Personal Timeline is created.
Anomalous Biomass now drops from Swarm Hives and the Alpha Flowerman.
The volume of Anomalous Biomass has been reduced so that more can be carried in the inventory.
Fixed incorrect tooltip text regarding the reward for a kill made by a Distorted Hunter.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45276524/a3f412e49cae6c508e808d025741f75f14d9a058.jpg"]This update fixes several crashes and PC graphics display errors while also restoring fall damage to its intended values. It also smooths out erroneous camera stutter when interacting with gravity anomalies, fixes a squad voice chat issue, and ensures the game remembers your last-selected raid type (Open or Isolated) across sessions.
Gameplay and Balance
Pressing the fence-cutting keybind again no longer cancel the action once it has begun.
Fixed instances of camera "jitter" when the direction of gravity changed.

Fall damage has been restored to its intended values. Falling from the roof of a three-story building will now most likely kill you, whereas jumping from a third-floor balcony, meaning from lower down than the roof, will likely just break your legs.
Weapons and Items
Fixed an issue where laser sights could point in the wrong direction during extraction.
Interface
The Missions Terminal now remembers the last selected raid type (Open or Isolated) and defaults to it the next time you launch the game.
Harmonization rewards now have a hint indicating that they need to be opened in the Monolith.
Changed the display of heavily damaged body parts in the raid results.
Fixed an issue where items in the Shop display could appear small and too distant.
Graphics and Performance
In Unstable Zone raids, visual noise on screen during zone shifts has been slightly reduced.
In Unstable Zone raids, fixed a bug causing image colors to display incorrectly.
In DirectX 11, fixed some crashes and graphical artifacts.
In DirectX 12, fixed a bug where some textures might not update after loading.
In DirectX 12, fixed a memory leak that could occur when resizing the game window.
In Vulkan: fixed several graphics display errors.
Sound
In squad voice chat settings, the "Always Active" activation mode no longer erroneously turns itself off after a microphone test.
Controls
Added a tab to allow players to edit mouse and keyboard control settings on XBOX.
Fixed a bug where the controller could stop working after changing the "Bigger small fonts" setting until the player switched to mouse and keyboard input and back again.
Fixed a rare bug where controller inputs could become completely blocked if the player caught fire while searching a crate.

In this update, markers made on the map, and shown on the compass, now show distance and elevation more clearly. The “Repair All” inventory button now also repairs armor being carried as spares, and DualSense touchpad functionality hs been improved. We’ve also decluttered the map — loot icons and zone labels are hidden until entering interative map mode, and monster lairs are now initially marked as you approach them. A bug that allowed loading more ammunition into a weapon than it can hold has been fixed too.
Screen darkening from being outside the playable zone has been reduced and is now consistent across all locations.
Moster lairs now only appear on the map when you get closer than 30m. A discovered lair stays on the map until end of the raid or until it’s neutralized.

A loot zone border color now indicates the rarest loot within in it. Loot icons and lablels have been removed from the map to reduce visual clutter; but the loot list is still visible when hovering over the zone on the map.
Zone names on the raid map are now displayed only when in interactive map mode.
The distance to markers is now displayed on both the map and the compass, and player marks on the compass now include an arrow indicating whether the target is above or below you.
When hovering over a player marker, you can now see how much time remains until it’s automatically removed and how close you need to get for it to now disappear.
The marker selection menu now shows the radius in meters for the “Nearby” option.
If you set the transparency slider for your own markers or ally markers to minimum, the markers now will be completely hidden. At any other value, they remain visible.
Fixed an issue where the marker icon next to a squadmate's name in the squad inteface was either missing or empty.
Fixed an issue where reloading a weapon could result in loading more ammunition than the weapon's capacity allows.
The "Repair All" inventory button now also repairs armor stored in your rig, backpack, or safe container, in addition to the armor you currently have equipped.

DualSense touchpad: in the menus, a single finger moves the controller cursor, a tap acts as a button press; using two fingers allows for scrolling through lists, as well as panning and zooming on the map. A separate setting is no longer required for this, and using the touchpad doesn’t exit controller mode.
Aiming via the touchpad during a raid is still enabled via the settings as before.
Two-finger map zooming now centers on the point between your fingers, rather than on the center of the map. This also applies to touchscreens.
DualSense adaptive trigger effects are disabled while a cursor is visible on the screen, such as when using the chat.

Fixed muzzle flash hiders as they now once again help conceal your position when firing. Resolved several gameplay bugs in raids and made interface improvements. Controls have been further refined and performance on consoles has been improved. Large monster clusters have returned to Isolated Raids, and Flowermen dash behavior has been adjusted.
Fixed an issue where fall damage could erroneously be applied twice during a single hard landing.
Bodies of players who died from falling no longer clip through and get stuck underneath the ground.
Killing Seeds with an explosion now correctly credits the kill to the player who dealt the damage in player statistics.
Ball Lightnings no longer spawn directly on top of players when reappearing.
Drones no longer fly through dormant Shy Girls.
Updated default gear presets for new players.
Reduced delays between Flowermen dashes. Dashes no longer end prematurely.
Items on the ground no longer erroneously spray blood when hit with melee weapons.
Fixed muzzle flash hiders: they once again help conceal your shots and position.
Fixed an incorrect reload animation for weapons with an open-bolt design.
The Burst Injector can once again correctly be used from quick-access pockets.

Adjusted RPG-7 balance: reduced projectile damage, projectiles now take up more inventory space, and they have received a new name and description. The weapon's positioning in the player's hands has also been improved.
The PKM machine gun can now hold a round in the chamber.
In Isolated Raids on Ozernoe, Factory, Shegolskoe (all variations), and Airport, large anomaly concentration zones can once again be encountered.
Cargo Port: an "Abnormal Signal" zone has been moved away from the road and no longer blocks vehicle traffic.

"Strength Limit" Investigation: the contract requiring a supply drop is now guaranteed to be completed, as "Volkov’s Signal Grenade" will appear in your personal stash. Use it to call in a separate drop and open it - the task will be counted. Regular supply drops no longer count for this task.

Investigation contracts no longer jump around in the list after completion: each stays consistent in its place in the Investigations menu. After closing an Investigation, you can track its narrative and story in order, step by step.
Hired Ops: the allies list no longer pushes objectives off the screen’s edge, and player management buttons in this list are no longer cut off.

On consoles, a squad where the leader plays on keyboard and mouse while a member uses a controller can once again enter raids. Instead of blocking, the keyboard and mouse player now only sees a warning. If the leader changes this setting, the member loses ready status and must confirm again.
After dying in a raid, pressing a keybind to exit now triggers a confirmation prompt if there is still an ally you can spectate.
The Quick Access action selection menu no longer opens if the character is dead.
Player-made markers on the map no longer overlap key area coordinates on the compass.
When inspecting a weapon, scope magnification no longer incorrectly displays as x1.2 instead of x1, and text on the inspection screen is now easier to read.
Settings in the "Interface" options tab are now grouped, making it easier to find what you need.
Improved performance in areas with dense vegetation on consoles.
Fixed game freezing on Steam Deck and Linux when minimizing the game.
The special Distorted now has a unique aggression scream: it can no longer be confused with the sound when becoming a Distorted Hunter.

Added DualSense adaptive triggers settings with three options: "Off," "Weak," and "Strong" (default). The "Combat Vibration" setting now only controls vibration, and trigger effects are no longer tied to it. Available on PS5 and PC when using a Sony controller.
If DualSense adaptive triggers are enabled, aiming (L2) and shooting (R2) now activate when you push through the stiff portion of the trigger travel, not at the very start of the button press.

Free look: when you release the look key, the camera now smoothly returns to the aiming direction instead of snapping back abruptly. If you're aiming at that moment, the return is still instant as before.

For controllers on PC and XBOX, the default stick dead zones have been increased to recommended values for XBOX, preventing stick wear from causing the character to move or turn on their own. Any custom values ​​set by the player will be preserved.
On XBOX and PlayStation®, the on-screen keyboard will no longer appear when selecting a text field if a physical keyboard is connected, such as in profile notes.

Fixed an issue where the camera would abruptly rotate 180 degrees when aiming while lying on one's back inside a gravitational anomaly. Also slightly reduced the angle you can raise or lower the camera while prone.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45276524/8a5ad49b69555b1da52d5ef4268954efcb0490f9.jpg"]Fixed bugs with gear presets, refined lighting in dark areas and at night, restored the intended recoil to pistols, and fixed some issues with item collection contracts.
Gear presets now equip correctly when pressing the "Purchase and Equip" button.
Gear presets are now purchased without camouflages: if the preset included a camouflage on a weapon, it won't be purchased or applied. You can apply one separately afterwards as normal.
Weapon price in a gear preset now accounts for modification costs and now correctly matches the amount deducted upon purchase.
Raid results no longer display a teammate's Active Matter instead of yours if the camera switched to observing a squad member after extraction.
Refined eye adaptation to lighting: at low light levels (basements, enclosed spaces), the image no longer becomes too bright.
Moonlight brightness is now more realistic relative to other light sources: night maps no longer look too bright.
Fixed an issue where players could not extinguish themselves when on fire while running when using default controls.
Fixed a weapon "twitch" in the player’s hands when the direction of gravity was changed: weapon inertia, sway and tilt now work smoothly in these areas.
Fixed a bug where pistol recoil was significantly lower than intended.

Item collection contract objectives now properly track if items were dropped or transferred to another player. It's no longer possible to collect just one of these items, transfer them to a teammate, and complete the contract for both players.

The weapon tactical flashlight and laser sight can once again be toggled separately. By default, both options are bound to the same control (“L” on keyboard), but you can assign a different binding to either of them in the controls settings.
If you previously assigned a separate key to the laser sight, it will be reset to the default keybind (“L” on keyboard) after the update. Reassign the key in the controls settings.

The maximum total number of players in Shegolskoe, Factory and Ozernoe Open Raids with “Solo only” matchmaking has been reduced, meaning that you’ll less often have to fight off players from several directions at once, also at the very start of raids after spawning in, on these smaller maps.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45276524/4e5f437d0a466587402e6c123c3c74c8221dd18a.jpg"]We’ve completely revamped control settings, including adding many new aiming settings for both mouse and keyboard as well as controllers. An option to further remove camera sway has been added, and in addition, we’ve improved sound positioning so that you can pinpoint the direction of threats more accurately.

Managing gear has become less of a hassle, magazines no longer can drop on reload, visual recoil when using scopes has been adjusted, and improved item swapping when changing backpacks and safe containers at the Shelter.
In large monster concentrations, enemies now spawn less often and in waves, and there's a dedicated device for clearing them out.
This is all, as always, in addition to countless other fixes and improvements!
Raids and Contracts
Collaborative Objective contracts for killing the Distorted are now working correctly again.
A kill made with a supply drop called in by a signal grenade is now shown on the victim's dog tag.
Reduced the darkening effect on screen when outside the playable zone on the "Military Base: Unstable Zone" raid.
The monster artifact marker on the "Military Base: Unstable Zone" raid map now appears earlier than before.
After finishing an Isolated Raid, a squad no longer has to start the raid search twice.
Fixed issues where the environment could disappear near the extraction point on Dogorsk.
Fixed a rare bug in the "Unstable Zone" raid variant that caused the zone to shrink around a point other than the final extraction portal.
Small green fences on the "Ozernoe" and "Factory" maps are now destructible.
The portal anomalies on the Cargo Port map’s barges are now safer: fixed a bug where a player could get stuck in scenery or fall off the barge after teleporting.
The raid list in the Missions Terminal menu now has a filter by raid type (Open, Isolated, Hired Ops), with an option to hide unavailable raids.
Weapons and Modifications
Adjusted visual recoil when firing in aim-down-sights mode, as the sight no longer obstructs the field of view during automatic fire.
Open-bolt weapons now correctly no longer keep a round in the chamber.
Weapons using subsonic ammunition now have a hint about quiet shooting with a suppressor.

When reloading, a new magazine is now taken from the rig first and then from the backpack, and the removed magazine no longer sometimes drops to the ground. Pressing reload again no longer interrupts the reload.

Optics: the sizes of a number of scopes and red dot sights, including the STG77 A1's integrated scope, have been changed. Variable scope magnification no longer drops below the weapon's base magnification level.
Fixed a rare bug that caused a sniper scope lens to disappear.
Thermal scopes no longer can erroneously display a bright white screen when aiming for the first time.
Fixed bugs where several grips could display visually in the same place on the SCAR-H.

Added new aiming settings: "Constant ADS zoom" gives the same magnification at any field of view, and "Aiming speed independent of FOV" which also removes rotation acceleration when using a different field of view.
Fixed a sharp visual "jerk" that occurred when throwing a grenade.
Gameplay
Statues now drop remains.

The camera no longer clips through the weapon when aiming prone. To achieve this, the upward view angle while lying on your stomach is limited to 50 degrees; but when rolling onto your back it smoothly increases to 90 degrees, so targets above you remain reachable.
Extraction portal visual effects no longer erroneously disappear if a Ball Lightning explodes nearby.
Inventory and Items
When swapping a backpack or safe container at the Shelter, its contents are now transferred to the new container automatically, and anything that doesn't fit is moved to the stash.
Loadout templates no longer strip detachable modification slots from equipment: the scope, grip and magazine stay on the weapon, and NVGs stay on the helmet.

Large medkits with identical values stack correctly again, the medkit description now shows healing per unit of time, and refining a medkit with charges inside now gives the correct number of Credits.
Healing items now all belong to the correct loot type: the icon in the pickup hint has been fixed.
Fixed issues where a drone’s inventory is not shown correctly, and items prohibited from being placed in containers can no longer be placed into the drone.
Fixed a bug that caused the PNV-57E night vision device to display incorrectly (floating above the operative’s head) in the squad loadout window.
When reducing the number of fusion runs, surplus resources are unloaded from the Workshop’s interface back to the storage.
The "Rusty Lock" now counts as industrial scrap, and the "Pruning Shears" no longer do.
Enemies
Small enemy habitats have been reworked: monsters in them no longer respawn on their own. Instead, a rift has appeared next to each of them, through which monsters can be summoned for Active Matter.

Large monster lairs have been reworked: enemies now respawn less often and in waves. A new neutralization device has been added for clearing such concentrations. Set it up and defend it from attacks until it triggers. If the device is destroyed, the attacks will resume.
There are now noticeably fewer activator flower traps in Flowermen zones.
No more than three "guards" are now present at extraction points at the same time.
Flowermen animations have been refined: it's now easier to tell when enemies are turning in place. They also have a new dash that they use after freezing.
The Distorted that spawn next to a player no longer erroneously lose interest or lie back down to sleep right under the player's feet.
Fixed a bug that could cause a Devourer’s body to be transparent.
Improved navigation for Alpha Mimics located at the edges of the playable zone.
Controls and Settings
The controls menu has been restructured by input mode: devices are split into "Controller" and "Mouse" tabs. Section headers are styled the same as on the options page.
The keys for switching interface tabs and pages are now rebindable.
Actions have been simplified: quick heal now also puts out fire, and a single key toggles both the flashlight and laser. Reviving with the bound "use" key works again.

Fixed controller-related bugs: quick lean no longer enables aiming or throws a grenade, zeroing works while aiming, leaning and selecting lighting no longer trigger extra actions, and the bumper menu no longer closes on lean.
Holding a key assigned to the quick access bar no longer interferes with clicks in the radial menu or causes the weapon to fire.
Pressing the PrintScreen key now consistently captures an in-game screenshot.
Added cursor settings for controller input: speed and stickiness.
Added a setting to stop music when taking damage.
The top compass is now a separate setting: it can be enabled together with the ring on the watch.
The new "Reduce camera sway" setting makes changes in view direction smoother when turning.
Controller: Aiming

The aiming stick is now processed differently: diagonals are no longer slower than the axes, and the axis snap sector matches the slider. Added new settings: vertical sensitivity, response curve (standard, linear, dynamic), outer threshold, axial dead zone, and turn acceleration at the stick's edge with a ramp-up time.

Added a separate aiming sensitivity setting for controller, independent of the mouse, and a sensitivity setting by scope magnification range: up to 2x, 2x–3x, 3.5x–6x, 7x and above. The same per-magnification setting is also available for mouse and keyboard.
Added a new "Gradual ADS Sensitivity" setting. With it, stick sensitivity when aiming changes gradually rather than abruptly.
The "Aim acceleration" setting has been given a new, correct name: "Aim smoothing".
A separate preset for Sony controllers has been added on PC. The settings preset is selected manually; button prompts adapt to the connected controller when Steam Input is disabled.
A live stick test showing drift has been added to the dead zones section.
Added a vibration strength slider (0–100%), a setting for vibration when firing, and light vibration on reload and bolt clicks.
Vibration has been added to the Linux client.
Controller is now the default input method on Windows handheld PCs, not just on Steam Deck.
DualSense and DualShock 4 on PC

Sony controllers are now read directly: the gyroscope, vibration, light bar, touchpad and adaptive triggers are available. The right trigger conveys the weapon's state: a jammed weapon locks the trigger, a loaded one increases trigger resistance depending on the weapon class, and during automatic fire the trigger pulses in time with the shots. Holding your breath is felt as vibration in the left trigger.

A controller switched off over Bluetooth no longer stays in the list of connected devices; when connected via cable and Bluetooth at the same time, the cable connection is used. An XBOX controller connected at the same time as a DualSense no longer disconnects.
If the controller is intercepted by Steam Input, a hint is shown in the controls settings.
Added gyro aiming with additional settings.
DualSense and DUALSHOCK 4 on PC now use the same vibration profiles as on PlayStation: shooting, reloading, healing and even menu clicks feel stronger.
Healing with a medkit, injector or painkiller now comes with a soft controller vibration and a light camera shake. Vibration strength depends on your settings.
Aim Assist

Aim assist now also works when hip firing, but in a weakened form: only aim turn slowdown applies, and within a smaller radius than when aiming. Snapping, tracking and motion compensation are still enabled only when aiming.
At close range with an enemy, aim turn slowdown and aim snapping to the enemy now activate within a smaller radius, and the slowdown disappears when the target abruptly moves sideways.
Snapping when aiming now lands exactly on the target at any frame rate.
Target tracking has been reworked: it now applies while the player is moving the stick and turning the view, not only the weapon. Added a tracking strength slider; pull values have been raised.
Interface

The Action Menu has been visually reworked: added status display (on/off) and weapon fire mode display. Laser sights and flashlights on weapons can now be toggled directly through this menu, without opening the lighting radial menu.
The squad panel now shows incoming invites (with hourglass icons) and lets you withdraw them. It's now visible when cross-play with all platforms is enabled in the squad and which member enabled it.
The map and player list screen in Hired Ops no longer goes beyond the edges of the screen or overlaps other elements at a 90–95% safe area on console.
Fixed loadout cost in Hired Ops and added display of the current cost of the selected kit.
In the Body Sleeve menu, hovering over a secondary Chronogene no longer adds its bonuses to the one being replaced, and changed values are now highlighted.
The compass at the top of the screen is now higher contrast so it's easier to see against the sky.
Resetting the control settings now visually updates the sliders on screen.
Hives now have their own icon in the raid results log instead of a skull.
The arrow buttons in the shop bundle offers no longer enlarge on hover on console.
Restored the ability to switch modification pages in the weapon card when using a controller.
Graphics and Performance
Active Matter orbs: fixed distortion at the sides of the screen, the distortion color, and the overlap of other distortion effects behind them.
Screen-space reflections: smooth convex surfaces no longer reflect themselves, mirror surfaces no longer smear thin geometry, and grass in puddles no longer has a bright rim.
Reduced interface stuttering when opening the Missions Terminal menu, crafting and fusion windows, the Investigations menu, when refreshing the raid list, and in the Shelter.
Optimized vegetation rendering in areas where Flowermen gather.
Fixed a bug that caused artifacts on trees when using Vulkan.
On PCs with Intel Raptor Lake processors and NVIDIA graphics cards, the game now launches on DirectX 12 by default.
Sound
Fixed a bug where, when using voice chat near other players, the server could mistakenly mute everyone speaking.
Improved spatial sound positioning: the source can be located more precisely by direction and by height. Improved the settings for sounds behind walls.
Updated the sounds of taking melee hits and the firing sounds of the M4 and M4A1.
The suppressed PM-63 and PP-91 Kedr are now classified as subsonic weapons in terms of audibility range: their shots are heard from a shorter distance than supersonic ones.
In active headphones mode, your own weapon's shots are now slightly louder, while Alpha Mimic footsteps and the swimming and movement in water of other players and monsters are quieter.

Alpha Mimic footsteps are now more clearly distinguishable by distance and are not muffled in combat, so a Mimic no longer sneaks up from behind silently. The Alpha Mimic's attack is now more audible.
Teleportation (using portals) and mine sounds are now less harsh, and the volume of the ringing in your ears when stunned has been reduced.
The dialogue volume setting now adjusts only Miss Second's lines and doesn't affect the player's quick voice messages.
Extended the search time of the auto-fill squad feature, it should find players twice as often now.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45276524/6e0de8ca623efeadc5ebc76a6ad3f94462ae7dab.jpg"]Reworked "Guts" and "Ghost" Body Sleeves, sped up magazine handling, improved daytime indoor visibility, added keyboard and mouse support for consoles, upgraded voice chat quality, increased armor and helmet resistance against melee attacks, boosted M82A1 lethality, made large medkits more effective, and resolved many bugs. This is all alongside countless other improvements!
Rare "Guts" and "Ghost" Body Sleeves have been reworked: they are now "epic" Body Sleeves with the same characteristics as the "Knight" and "Paladin" Body Sleeves.
In Isolated (PvE) Raids, Invisibles and Hellhounds no longer suddenly spawn near players who remain in one area for a long time.
Accelerated magazine handling: loading ammunition is now 20% faster, and unloading is roughly 15% faster.
Fixed a bug where shotguns could endlessly load shells and interrupting such a reload worked incorrectly.
Armor plates and helmets now take 70% less damage from melee weapon and monster attacks.
Melee weapon and buttstock strikes now align more precisely with the animation: damage and hit effects trigger at the correct moment.

AK-15SK: Added a dedicated suppressor instead of the generic 7.62x39 suppressor. Purchasing, replicating and fusing this suppressor unlocks in the Monolith during the "250 Shades of Liberty" Cycle upon reaching 80% Harmonization.
AK-15SK: Shot grouping improved, recoil reduced.
M82A1: Damage increased by approximately 8%.
STG77 A1: Muzzle flash reduced.
AI-2 First Aid Kit: Heals 20% faster; medicine charge supply reduced from 400 to 300 units, volume increased to 50.
Big First Aid Kit: Medicine charge supply increased from 1600 to 1650, restores 75 units per tick instead of 50;
Medical Bag: Restores 75 units per tick instead of 50.
RSh-12 pistol icon now displays correctly in the Shop.

From the very beginning of the game, players have access to Fusion recipes and Replicator blueprints for the AI-2 First Aid Kit, the small UHMWPE armor plate, the PP-91 Kedr, and the Bayonet Knife, as well as the Fusion recipe for Distorted remains.
Fusion recipes for Shy Girl and Scorches (regular and pristine) remains are now granted when extracting their remains from a raid.

Fusion recipes for Flowermen, Invisible, Hellhound, and Turned Soldier remains are now granted along with the Monolith unlock that opens the corresponding Investigations, or when extracting their enriched remains from a raid.
Replication time for the AI-2 First Aid Kit and the small UHMWPE armor plate reduced to 30 seconds.
Replication time for PP-91 Kedr and PM-63 is now 10 minutes.
Fixed a bug where the number of replications in the Replicator exceeded the maximum.
Escape from Dogorsk: added the ability to complete Investigations requiring a visit to the standard Dogorsk raid.
Equipped gear is no longer lost if internet connection failures prevent players from spawning into a raid.

Added a new Sergei Volkov Investigation "Breaking Point." It unlocks the "Guts" Body Sleeve. The investigation is available at Monolith level "LAMBDA." The "Guts" Body Sleeve can now only be obtained through the investigation.
Maximum aim assist distance now depends on the magnification of the equipped or built-in sight.
Target switching has become smoother: aim slowdown when transitioning from one enemy to another no longer happens with an abrupt jerk.
Separate sliders for adjusting aim slowdown strength and target auto-tracking have been added to control settings.
Console players can now play with keyboard and mouse.
Aim assist now only works when playing with a controller (when switching to it from keyboard and mouse, the function activates after a brief delay).

In raids with only console players, keyboard and mouse is disabled for the duration of the raid so no one gains an advantage over controller players. Your personal control settings remain unchanged, the controller continues to work with any selected control type, and prompts display controller buttons. When entering such a raid, players see a restriction message. Isolated Raids are not subject to this restriction.
A "Keyboard and Mouse" option has been added to crossplay settings on consoles. Searching solo or as a squad leader with this enabled restricts matchmaking strictly to raids containing PC players.
Added a warning before starting a raid if keyboard and mouse will be disabled in the selected mode.

On consoles, when playing with keyboard and mouse, the controller no longer skips the first input after using the keyboard. When entering a raid with device restrictions, the cursor and keyboard and mouse prompts now hide correctly.

Fixed visual bugs that occurred with the "Reduce camera bobbing" setting enabled. Jumping, crouching, turning in place, and starting to walk while crouched now look the same as with the setting disabled.
Added a setting to reduce camera sway from the character’s breathing.
Fixed items disappearing at the bottom of the storage when the Refiner is filled, as well as empty space appearing under the storage after moving multiple items.
Enlarged the button for moving items from temporary storage to main storage.
The quick loadout block in the raid preparation window is now visually highlighted.
Removed the ability to shoot and aim with the controller while the inventory is open if the cursor is not hovering over an item.
Added an option to controller settings that disables melee attacks while aiming.
When navigating to Monolith from the Shop via the RSh-12 link, the correct item is now immediately selected.
Fixed an error that occurred when trying to buy a Harmonization Cycle reward in the store without being a participant.
Fixed an error that occurred when opening the inventory with temporary storage.
Added an explanation to the Personal Timeline creation window that equipped items will be saved.
Fixed an error that occurred when quickly purchasing compatible modifications from a weapon slot in inventory using a controller.
The current track in the player now has new "Add to favorites/ignored" buttons.
Three new exclusive tracks are now available as Fundamental Protocol (Cycle 0) rewards in the Harmonization menu.
The first syllable when talking is no longer cut off, and there are no more clicks at the end of talking.
Short talking periods during push-to-talk no longer sound quieter than long ones.
Quiet speech in noisy environments sounds louder and clearer, while lowering background noise amplification between spoken words. Microphone volume changes in the settings are applied immediately.
Voice no longer sounds harsh and "metallic" on sibilant sounds.
Game sounds no longer get into voice chat and drown out voices.
Fixed repetitions and instances of speech fragments dropping out during brief lag spikes.
Changed lighting adaptation settings: rooms during daytime no longer appear too dark.

Reduced instances of stuttering in scenes with high graphics load.
Vulkan: fixed possible lighting artifacts after graphics device resets.
Fixed flickering and image artifacts on Steam Deck and some AMD graphics cards when using Vulkan, as well as stuttering when video memory is insufficient.
Fixed instances of freezes in DirectX 11, including when resizing the window and recovering from errors.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45276524/8057ad255a68fd4fe7bfce88594847397b842628.jpg"]Extraction points on Headquarters, Airport and Downtown now have more cover. Finding the location you need for a contract on the map is also now easier. Molotov Cocktails and Incendiary Grenades now ignite targets instantly, rather than with a delay. Alongside all of this, a number of client hangs and crashes were fixed, and performance improvements were made.
Updated Molotov Cocktails and Incendiary Grenades to immediately ignite enemies splashed with the flammable mixture. Previously, 1–2 seconds in the flame were required to catch fire.
Updated Devourers to take damage from flamethrowers and areas of fire.
Updated raid spawn rules so that turning on an equipped flashlight, weapon tactical flashlight, or laser sight immediately ends the short invisibility period when spawning into a raid.
Drones and Binoculars can no longer be used while driving a vehicle.
Fixed an issue where Mimics and Statues dealt melee damage to Operatives inside armored vehicles. Base damage statistics for both anomalies remain unchanged.
Flowermen gathering spots are now populated as intended. Previously, a bug could leave some of these spots fully empty when a raid begins.
Updated Fireballs to properly display as thermal heat sources when targeted through thermal sights.
Fixed bugs that allowed the Gravity Gun to create incorrect zones at the point of impact or on a miss. These zones could cause Operatives to get stuck.
Relocated stationary evacuation points in the Headquarters, Airport, and Downtown raids closer to nearby buildings and added cover nearby.
Adjusted Devourers spawn locations in the Airport raid; they no longer appear at Investigation points of interest.
Fixed a misplaced gravity zone in the Dam raid that overlapped a staircase.
Fixed a bug that allowed players to go beyond the boundaries of the Mir Factory map in Hired Ops.
Fixed a bug that prevented climbing out of the water via a ladder in the Dam raid.
Fixed a bug that could cause an Operative to get stuck in an elevator in the Downtown raid.
It's now easier to find the contract location you need on the map: hovering over a contract in the list makes its icons and zones pulse, while other contracts and map layers are dimmed.
In the contract reward window, you can now individually select items to send for quick refining.
Open Raids now have an amber icon instead of a blue one.
Raid variant toggle icons have been enlarged.
If an Open Raid is unavailable due to the raid rotation schedule, it now shows the opening time and a hint that you can go on an Isolated Raid in the meantime.
When selecting Provided Equipment on the Loadout Check screen, instead of the previous warning, the list of selected Investigations that cannot be completed with that gear is now shown.
Fixed a bug where the cost of reviving a squadmate failed to update dynamically with the number of revivals.
Damage direction indicators now occupy a smaller area in the center of the screen.
The damage indicator now always shows the direction of incoming damage relative to the world, so it now properly rotates together with the camera.
The damage indicator has become more noticeable and stays on screen longer.

Directionless damage (e.g., asphyxiation, vehicle collisions) no longer covers the entire screen with blood splatter. Also, fixed a bug that caused some monster attacks to be incorrectly treated as directionless damage.
Fixed gamepad navigation in the emote wheel so that the selected sector no longer persists the next time the window is opened.
Fixed an audio bug causing side panel open sounds to loop repeatedly on the raid results screen.
Fixed bugs in the rendering of certain environment objects that could cause client hangs and graphics device resets.
Fixed rare Vulkan visual artifacts occurring on AMD and Intel GPUs.
Improved performance in locations with a large amount of vegetation and small environmental objects.
Fixed a crash occurring when completing an Isolated Raid on PlayStation®.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45276524/9a535e7139f9ac6b1ed6fbd8131199ed31d3be14.jpg"]Operatives! Here is a quick update following your feedback. We’ve adjusted Distorted pursuit behavior and noise sensitivity, made fire damage from Molotovs and flamethrowers affect monsters more reliably again, and restored your ability to squeeze past surrounding groups of monsters.
Distorted that teleport in front of a fleeing player now appear farther away, giving you more time to react.
Agitated Distorted animate more visibly, making it easier to see whether their sleep is restless, and that they could wake up at any moment.
Bullet impacts now generate noticeably less noise for monsters, meaning that they react less to them. Firing with a suppressor is also now even less likely to wake nearby groups.
Monsters now stop reacting to noise faster and fall into deep sleep faster.

Fixed a bug that made monsters walk around Molotov and flamethrower fire, so it could not be used against them. Monsters now pass through such fire and take damage from it. Bonfires and other permanent fire sources are still avoided by all monsters: the bug came from that mechanic, and the mechanic itself is kept.

We've restored old collision physics with monsters: it's now easier to break out of an encirclement by pushing enemies aside. However, this occasionally can cause you to end up inside a monster again — we're continuing to work on a fix for this issue.

When firing in full-auto, the sight now tracks weapon recoil accurately and correctly again. Previously, a bug could cause the sight position to drift from the actual point of impact. Recoil itself is unchanged.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45276524/70f3ef7d420a9998b4242aa5f879b9bd39179519.jpg"]This update makes extraction safer on Dalniy Island with relocated exit points and new cover, improves stability with fewer crashes, makes Seeds give up the chase sooner and prevents Hellhounds from spawning on rooftops. We have also adjusted how Distorted pursue targets that run from them — see the developer note in the Enemies section.
Enemies
Reduced the pursuit range of Seeds: they now give up the chase sooner.
Fixed an issue where Hellhounds could spawn on rooftops.

Distorted that are already chasing a fleeing target will now occasionally teleport ahead of it. The teleport brings them out of cover and into your line of fire, where they are easier to hit. Distorted health, damage, and spawn numbers are unchanged, and Distorted that have not noticed you behave exactly as before.

Developer note: Until now, a reliable counter to a Distorted was to run, and a monster that can always be outrun stops being a threat. This change only affects Distorted that are already pursuing you: sneaking past them or fighting them works the same as before. If you choose to run, expect one to cut you off — and to be standing in the open when it does, which can make them easier to defeat. We are also looking into reports that silenced weapons feel less effective since Distorted packs grew.
Fixed monster collision models so that monsters no longer overlap each other or the player. As a result, it is harder to slip through a tight group of monsters, so keep your distance instead.
Fixed the terrain placement of Hellhound portals relative to the ground on the "Shegolskoe: Distortion" raid.
Gameplay and Items

Painkillers are now consumed only when the usage animation completes. It is no longer possible to keep the item by canceling the animation at the last moment. Usage auto-cancels if you get back up for another reason, and manual cancellation remains available.
Reduced the chance of receiving duplicate rewards for turning in multiple Operative Objectives.
Updated the "Key" fusion recipe's required components.
Added the ability to select specific target dummies from a list at the shooting range's console.
Raids and Maps
Improved extraction point safety on Dalniy Island raids: several exposed stationary extraction points have been moved closer to structures, and cover has been added nearby.
Fixed errors preventing the "Point of Support" Investigation from being completed in the Airport raid.
Added vehicle delivery points to the "Escape from Dogorsk" raid, resolving an issue where Vehicle Transfer contracts completed automatically due to missing delivery locations.
Adjusted gravity platforms on several maps, including at the Ozernoe fire station, so that movement no longer stutters when running across them.
Fixed a bug preventing players from climbing ladders near buildings #1 and #8 in Ozernoe raids.
Reduced the intensity of storm visual effects within Unstable Zone raids. Storms remain part of the Unstable Zone's borders; only the visual intensity has been toned down.
Fixed an issue causing players to get stuck in the Park raid.
Fixed a bug that prevented players from firing their weapons after leaving a sensor deployment zone during a raid.
Weapons and Modifications
Fixed tactical flashlight activation not working properly when mounted on a dual-rail adapter.
Fixed hand placement when using MP and F-Dev RTK angled grips.
Fixed player hands clipping through various modifications on the AK-15SK and PPK-20.
Controls

Fixed input conflicts between player actions and Shelter Edit Mode controls. Building commands now have their own dedicated section in the Controls settings with updated default keybindings. If your building keys feel different, check the new section to review or rebind them.
Improved Shelter wall-item placement: optimized initial selected positions, sharpened placement point accuracy, and wall-mounted objects now ignore the "Rotate with player" setting.
Interface
Updated contract colors so that they match the icons on the map, and fixed an issue where Collaborative Objectives spawning mid-raid would override the colors of existing contracts.
Fixed issues where inventory items shifted abruptly under the cursor when a row disappeared.
Fixed instances where rig section items overflowed past the container border when scrolling.

Operatives! The Agency has recently mapped the fundamental processes connecting all Harmonization Cycles and, with that insight, distilled them into a new, unified initiative: the Fundamental Protocol.

Rewards in this Protocol can be redeemed with Merits at any time, whether or not you’re currently participating in a Harmonization Cycle! Rewards include consumables, unique decorations, Credits, and Monolith Tokens — everything you need to accelerate your push toward establishing your new Personal Timeline.
The Fundamental Protocol lets you spend earned Merits even if you’re not participating in any other Cycle.
Access to it unlocks at Monolith access level DELTA. If you’ve already reached DELTA, access will be granted automatically.
Your access to the Fundamental Protocol persists after you create a new Personal Timeline.
Some rewards are exclusive to the Fundamental Protocol and therefore can only be obtained there.

Active Matter’s major update “Gigastructure” is now live! It adds a new raid — Park — as well as the Alpha Flowerman boss, new weapons, a gravity gun, more weapon modifications (including pistol grips and laser sights), a new Harmonization of the Multiverse system, Shelter customization options, and much more!

Park;

“Collaborative Objectives”: Labelled “TO ALL AGENTS” in game, these are random global missions for all raid participants that require teaming up with players outside your group to complete;

Operative objectives have been introduced and are issued to players sequentially — the next is granted after completing the previous one.

Monolith Tokens are not awarded for completing operative objectives.

In addition to new submachine guns, sniper rifles, a machine gun and a machine pistol, the game will feature a unique weapon — the Gravity gun. It lets you create tunnels that transport the player from the firing point to the impact point. This allows Operatives to avoid fall damage, opening up many potential tactical maneuvers, however it can only be found in raids and cannot be brought back to the Shelter in one piece.

Added the Gravity gun to supply drops.

OM Laser Sight (red);

AN-PEQ-15 Laser Sight (red);

Added various new pistol grip modifications for AK and AR platform rifles.
Added new suppressors for the RPK-74 and M-series rifles.
Added new muzzles for the SV-98 and M-series rifles.
Added a new camouflage Appearance setting option for Body Sleeves.
Added \ (small) armor plate slots to both hands;
Changed leg armor plate slots from \ (small) to \ (large);
Changed default perks to +50% Explosion dmg. protection and +10% Additional healing for all body parts.
Increased Submachine gun damage by between 10-15% and reduced damage drop-off with distance.
Increased KS-23 damage by around 37% and updated its reload animation.
Increased ASh-12 damage and recoil by 20-25% and increased damage drop-off with distance.
Increased VSS Vintorez and AS VAL damage by around 7% and increased damage drop-off with distance.
Made minor adjustments to the behavior of various different calibers of rifle rounds in the range of 3% at distances of 100+ meters.
Added the new M8 Smoke grenade, releasing a smoke cloud that lasts for a while but is less intense than the RGD-M Smoke grenade.
Updated the RGD-M Smoke grenade to now create an instant smoke cloud on detonation that dissipates fairly quickly.
Breath Control - extends the time you can hold your breath while aiming;
Overflow Healing - applies part of ampule healing to all body parts.

Reworked synthesis recipes for Tier II and Tier III Chronogenes: outcomes now depend solely on input colors — e.g., three green guarantees a green Chronogene; two blue and one green favors blue over green.
Added a new compensator for the ASh-12.
Updated the SV-98 to use 7.62×54mm ammo.
Added a 10-round magazine for the M1911A1.
Increased 9×18mm caliber ammo damage.
Reduced recoil for the PM-63 and PP-91 Kedr.
Improved reload animations on the MTs 21-12 and AKM.
Updated reload sounds for all pistols.
Fixed a sound layering issue with the SPAS-12’s reload.
Fixed some sound artifacts with the SPAS-12 and Origin-12 shots.
Adjusted the magazine capacity of the PKM (PKM ammo box) and M249 Para (M249 ammo pouch) machine guns to 100 rounds.
Added a new Tank crew helmet.
Added a new PNV-57E Night vision device, which attaches to the new Tank crew helmet.
Added new active headphones, the Tactical headset, for the helmet slot, providing minimal head protection but improving the player’s hearing.

The Alpha Flowerman is a new boss — the next evolutionary stage of the regular Flowerman. It won’t be easy to take down, but operatives can expect a worthy reward for the risks taken.

Added the new Tentacle anomaly.

Added Alpha Mimic spawns on Dogorsk raid.

Anyone creating a new Personal Timeline will receive bonus season rewards, and will also speed up reward unlocks for other Operatives who choose to remain in the same timeline to obtain them later.

Harmonization of the Multiverse: unlock new items after a set number of new personal timelines have been created by all operatives, or automatically after enough time passes through “temporal progress”.

Reworked Operative level-up rewards: now you receive material rewards and can choose one of several passive skills from a tree that differs between players and after each new Personal Timeline created by the player.

Reworked objectives and their rewards: tasks are split into standard, Agent-level and Expert-level available with Monolith unlocks, added the option to reassign and swap objectives, and the player can now open new objective slots.

Added a quick chat command introduction to the tutorial.

Meet the "Fire Walk" update! New raids, weapons, equipment modifications, a revamped armor system, reworked Body Sleeves, and much more await you! We can't wait to tell you about all the changes.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45276524/30767a8aaa2a0ce9fd6f133aeb9cecf9ceb4af62.jpg"]Operatives can now tackle a brand-new raid, “Dam.” Also, the familiar “Dogorsk” is no longer confined to just isolated play - you can now face off against other operatives for valuable loot.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45276524/f5d074e4551d92fcc83588f3bd02250a3fdd6285.jpg"]New weapon types are joining the arsenal - machine guns, shotguns, and even handheld grenade launchers. Operatives can also fit their weapons with new modifications.

We’ve also expanded the list of weapons that can equip suppressors. The PBS-1 Suppressor now fits the AKM and Vepr-KM VPO, matching real-world specs. The PBS-4 Suppressor is now compatible with the 5.45×39 mm AK series (AK-74M, AKS-74U). The HX6 Suppressor now fits the AK-103, and a bayonet-mount adapter version is available for the AK-12.
Weapons found in raids will now more often include suitable modifications already installed and will frequently appear in airdrops.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45276524/73eb213c7e9a505123190d7bf86dabccfd3f042d.jpg"]In this update, we’ve reworked the armor system by adding new plate types and sizes. Titan plates are now the most durable - and most expensive - though they initially absorb slightly less damage than ceramic plates. You’ll need to choose your gear based on your objectives and your confidence in the field.

We’ve also introduced two new helmets - EDH-Gen V and TFMK-I - equipped with active headsets that suppress loud noises while amplifying quieter sounds. For a deeper dive, check out our recent dev diary.
In raids, you can now find modified equipment - like weapons with improved accuracy or more spacious backpacks - so keep your eyes peeled for the best loot!
Dalny Island now offers Western weapons and gear alongside Soviet equipment. These Western items are rarer, hinting at the presence of operatives from other branches of the multiverse.

releases.displayName: Active Matter is getting the biggest update in online shooters’ history

items.text: Dear fighters, get your weapons ready and prepare for the most incredible adventure of your life — the universe of our game is becoming even bigger, bolder and more amazing!

Now you can create your own clan and challenge other teams in a large-scale conquest of the multiverse of 40,000 unique realities! Fight for worlds where dinosaurs live side by side with people, where humanity thrives in an ideal utopian state, where civilization is frozen in the harsh Middle Ages or desperately fights for survival after the fall of a devastating asteroid. Now only your clan decides the fate of the worlds!

Did you defeat your opponent? Now you can rip off his dogtag and take him prisoner. Just equip this tag in the next raid, and the captured operative will become your slave and will fulfill your wildest desires! Keep your enemies in fear, increase the army of captured soldiers and try not to get captured yourself.

Who said that war must be won by force of arms? Challenge your opponents to a merciless dance-battle, demonstrate your best moves and prove to the entire multiverse who is the real king of the dance floor.

Only 100 of the most devoted fans will be able to receive a special edition, which includes a smartwatch with a personal AI assistant "Miss Second", always ready to support you in and out of battle. In addition, the set includes a personal dogtag with your name (or any other, of your choice). The basic edition of the game will cost only $999.
The pre-order opening announcement will be published soon.
Prepare your weapons, gather your friends, learn your dance moves and wait for the grand update. 40,000 worlds are waiting for you to conquer them!
